title: Mini Handheld Game Console Memory Game Console Keychain
body_html:
Product Information：

Material: plastic
Function: flash, music/voice
Product category: memory game console
Whether electric: yes
Power supply mode: battery
Color: blue, pink, black, white, yellow


Introduction to memory magic gameplay
1. Start the game, press the middle memory button to start the game.
2. According to the flashlight prompt, press the corresponding button, each level adds a button, and every 5 levels is an advanced level (the game is over if the designated button is not pressed within 10 Seconds)
3. Successfully advanced, there will be cheers and applause when the game is cleared
4. If you press the wrong button or do not operate within 10 seconds, there will be a dizzy sound to remind you immediately after the failure.


Packing List：

Keychain*1
